title: Real-rate strain conditioning of filed debt-stock leverage: long low-fixed-debt/short high-fixed-debt books, sector-neutral on the death-inclusive 154-clock PIT panel, gated by the vintaged DFII10 real-yield regime

mechanism.forced_or_underreacting_party: Two-sided. (i) FORCED: financially levered firms whose maturing debt must be rolled at the prevailing real rate are forced transactors on the funding side - refinancing pressure transmits to equity through interest burden (filed LongTermDebtNoncurrent stock) with a lag the firm does not choose. (ii) UNDERREACTING: the equity holders of high-leverage firms are the slow party - the debt stock that determines their real-rate exposure exists only as filed SEC vintages read under as-of clocks (a stale, illiquid number absent from every price/volume screen), while the rate variable that reprices it is a TIPS-market real yield; investors anchor on nominal rate headlines (DGS10) and re-price filed leverage stacks slowly when the REAL discount-rate regime shifts, because the real-rate regime is not visible on any conventional data terminal screen they monitor.
mechanism.why_the_effect_exists: High real 10-year yields raise the real interest burden on the outstanding fixed-rate debt stock, tighten refinancing economics for maturing stacks (Kiyotaki-Moore collateral feedback), and compress the present value of distant earnings (levered equity is the bondlike claim in Fama-French's term structure reading; the cash-flow-duration reading of Campbell-Vuolteenaho says long-duration claims reprice most when real discount rates move). The effect concentrates on high-filed-leverage names (Bernanke-Campbell; Gertler-Gilchrist financial accelerator), which on this death-inclusive cohort include the levered names that actually die rather than being censored out of a survivor panel. The conditioning contains no price-series input by construction: the rank is two filed balance-sheet vintages; the gate is a rates LEVEL read point-in-time; the mispricing channel is slow re-rating, not fast price reaction. The death-inclusive universe is what makes the short leg honest: the high-debt names that succumb in a high-real-rate regime deliver their terminal leg instead of vanishing from the sample.
mechanism.what_observable_measures_it: L(t) = as-of vintage us-gaap:LongTermDebtNoncurrent divided by as-of vintage us-gaap:Assets, both read under the cited funded unbounded clocks (avail < gate(t), never latest-in-store); standardized to a percentile within the frozen sector tag s of the cohort row. Regime variable r(t) = vintaged DFII10 value in effect at the decision date (realtime_start <= D, latest such row), mapped to a band by the frozen expanding-percentile rule below. Conditioned book = regime weight w in {1.0, 0.5, 0.0} times the within-sector long-low-L/short-high-L tercile book.
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: The effect must fail (i) when the gated anchor expectancy <= 0 after base band costs - i.e., real-rate strain is already correctly priced and the filed-debt channel carries no premium; (ii) when the DGS10 exposure-form control reproduces the anchor at >= 0.5x same-sign expectancy - i.e., the information is plain rate-level beta-timing of a known characteristic, not real-rate strain; (iii) when the sham-macro placebo reproduces the anchor at >= 0.5x same-sign expectancy - i.e., it is generic timing, not the real-rate regime; (iv) when the always-on baseline beats the gated book - i.e., the regime gate destroys value and the conditioning claim itself is false; (v) when fewer than 2 of 3 folds are positive; (vi) when the D2 pooled |rho| vs any of the fourteen veto entries exceeds 0.20 measured on conditioning exposures.
mechanism.which_control_kills_the_convenient_expla: The convenient explanation is 'this is just being short levered names (or just rate beta) dressed as macro conditioning'. The exposure-form control (DGS10 nominal-yield conditioning at the SAME 30 dates, SAME rank, SAME machinery) is the designated killer: if nominal-yield gating reproduces the real-rate anchor, the claimed mechanism is nominal beta-timing and the family dies per the P3 lane2 mandate. The sham-macro placebo (duration-preserving block permutation of the regime weights, frozen seed) kills the residual 'generic timing' explanation. A control that cannot run is a DESIGN FAILURE (P3 lane2 mandate); both controls here are runnable from pinned data alone.

lineage_citations: Bernanke, B.S., Campbell, J.Y. (1988), 'Is There a Corporate Debt Crisis?', Brookings Papers on Economic Activity 1988(1), 83-139 (interest-burden sensitivity of levered corporate balance sheets).
Kiyotaki, N., Moore, J. (1997), 'Credit Cycles', Journal of Political Economy 105(2), 211-248 (collateral/credit constraints transmit and amplify real-rate moves into levered firms' valuations).

Fama, E.F., French, K.R. (1993), 'Common Risk Factors in the Returns on Stocks and Bonds', Journal of Financial Economics 33(1), 3-56 (term-structure factor: levered equity carries bondlike duration exposure).

Campbell, J.Y., Vuolteenaho, T. (2004), 'Bad Beta, Good Beta', American Economic Review 94(5), 1249-1275 (cash-flow-duration vs discount-rate decomposition: long-duration claims reprice most when real discount rates move).

Gertler, M., Gilchrist, S. (1994), 'Monetary Policy, Business Cycles, and the Behavior of Small Manufacturing Firms', Quarterly Journal of Economics 109(2), 309-340 (financial accelerator: rate strain concentrates on financially constrained firms).

features_and_lags.leverage_feature_frozen: L(t) = as-of us-gaap:LongTermDebtNoncurrent / as-of us-gaap:Assets at decision date t under the two cited unbounded funded clocks; cross-sectional percentile computed WITHIN the frozen sector tag s; tercile bands (top/middle/bottom third of the within-sector ranked eligible names at the decision).
features_and_lags.regime_definition_frozen_ex_ante: r_i = vintaged DFII10 value in effect at frozen decision date D_i (the row with realtime_start <= D_i, the latest such row; no interpolation, no revision re-picking). Expanding-window inclusive percentile p_i = #{j <= i : r_j <= r_i} / i over the as-of values of the 30 frozen decision dates themselves (no look-ahead, no external seed, deterministic). Bands: HIGH if p_i >= 2/3 (w_i = 1.0); LOW if p_i <= 1/3 (w_i = 0.0); MID otherwise (w_i = 0.5). The weight ladder {1.0, 0.5, 0.0} is linear-in-band and frozen now; never tuned. Ties resolved by the <= in the count definition.
features_and_lags.hysteresis_frozen: regime hysteresis: the regime variable is evaluated ONLY at the 30 frozen decision dates and the weight is step-constant between consecutive decision dates (no intra-quarter switching, no smoothing, no interpolation). Rank hysteresis (inherited verbatim): a held name is retained until its rank exits its tercile band by more than one decile, effective holding 1-2 grid steps.
features_and_lags.vintage_asof_rule_mandatory_pit: PANEL: avail < gate(t) per the panel gate semantics (P-1: no asserted lags; SEC filed dates are the availability stamps). MACRO: vintaged as-of reconstruction verbatim from the frozen packet - value in effect at decision D = the row with realtime_start <= D, the latest such row; the realtime_start column IS the availability stamp; no publication-lag assertion is added anywhere. A row that is absent as-of D is not invented; the series are measured as-of bindable on 30/30 frozen dates for all three series (p2_coverage_gates.json), so the expected abstention count is zero and any actual abstention is fail-closed and reported.
features_and_lags.mutation_contract: P3 lane2 pit_rule binding: a macro vintage arriving late must move the decision EXACTLY one period (test-level contract); the same holds for a panel vintage's avail crossing gate(t) between decisions.
features_and_lags.vintage_mixing_declaration: rank numerator and denominator may come from different filings (no shared-effective-date requirement, V8-F1 precedent); the per-decision vintage-age distribution of both legs is reported with the run; the sham and DGS10 control arms share the identical mixing structure, so staleness artifacts apply equally to all arms and cancel in the falsification comparison rather than being argued away.
features_and_lags.no_price_input_declaration: no equity price series enters any rank or gate: the only price-derived quantities are the inherited eligibility/cost inputs (63-bar floor, ADV63 band, RAW price floor, returns for PnL).

entry_exit_fills.window_convention: STRICT_NEXT_BAR (P3 default): signals are computed from decision-date as-of information (panel avail < gate(t); macro realtime_start <= D); fills occur at the next allowed session close AFTER the decision session; no same-session fill (V3 ADJ-1-EXEC-CLOCK carried). Bookable bars have date > signal date.
entry_exit_fills.fill_and_exit_semantics: fill_check verbatim from P3: 'a fill references only names with a bar at the fill session; missing bar = the order does not exist (no silent substitute pricing)'. exit_at_last_close verbatim: 'a held name whose series ends is exited at its last recorded close on its final session (delisting-return leg carried by the price series itself; no synthetic penalty, no synthetic continuation)'
entry_exit_fills.fold_force_flat: the book is forced flat at every fold boundary (S0_FOLD_1 end 2020-09-01, S0_FOLD_2 end 2023-02-09; carried book folds from p3_v13_invariants_freeze.json): positions entered at the last decision date inside a fold close at that fold's final session; the next fold re-enters fresh at its first decision date.
entry_exit_fills.portfolio_construction: per-sector net-zero long-short: within each sector with >= 6 eligible ranked names, long the bottom-L tercile, short the top-L tercile, equal-weight within legs, per-sector net zero; CASH absorbs residual and holds the (1 - w_i) regime weight; at least 1 non-CASH leg required whenever w_i > 0 (a w > 0 decision with zero eligible names is a coverage defect, fail-closed and reported); gross capped 2.0; all books reconcile to 1.0 within 1e-9.
entry_exit_fills.costs: band model carried verbatim from p3_v13_invariants_freeze.json: 10/15/25 bps per side base for bands A/B/C (ADV63 >= 50M / 10-50M / 2-10M), stress x2 = 20/30/50; costs linear in fills, charged exactly once per fill, applied to BOOKED PnL; L-I3 fail-closed: a traded name without a computed band raises BandResolutionError (no silent fallback).
entry_exit_fills.turnover: quarterly reconstitution with one-decile exit hysteresis plus discrete regime-weight steps; turnover = sum(abs(delta_weight)) over non-CASH legs; annualized two-way expected well below the 6.0/year ceiling; raw and ceiling-normalized reported per arm.

anchor_arm.definition: DFII10-gated filed-debt leverage book. Rank L = LongTermDebtNoncurrent / Assets (cited unbounded funded clocks), within-sector terciles, LONG bottom tercile (low fixed-debt leverage) / SHORT top tercile (high leverage), per-sector net zero. Regime gate w_i from the frozen expanding-percentile DFII10 rule: HIGH 1.0 / MID 0.5 / LOW 0.0; forced MID on dates 0-4.
anchor_arm.claim: the gated book's expectancy after base band costs is positive with the risk-matched SPY excess positive overall, and the regime gate ADDS value over the always-on baseline (clause C6).
rerun_diagnostics_inside_cell: always-on baseline: the identical rank book with w held at 1.0 on all 30 dates (decomposes gating value from spread value; feeds falsification clause C6; not a scored cell)
stress x2 cost rerun (20/30/50 bps schedule)

neighbour_arm.definition: burden-breadth variation of the same mechanism: rank = Liabilities / Assets (cited unbounded funded clocks), within-sector terciles, LONG low / SHORT high total-liability leverage, identical DFII10 regime gate, identical machinery, grid, costs and semantics.
neighbour_arm.support_relation: REQUIRED same-sign expectancy support (P3 gate table, no relaxation): the anchor measures the fixed-debt stock channel; the neighbour measures the total-liability burden channel. If the neighbour carries the opposite sign, the fixed-debt and total-liability readings disagree, the interest-burden story is not supported, and the family is rejected - a support failure is an interpretation, never a tuning opportunity.

control_arms.exactly_three_scored_arms: anchor + neighbour + exposure-form control; the sham-macro placebo and always-on baseline are rerun-class diagnostics inside existing cells (V9 arm-accounting precedent); both proposals of this lane therefore consume exactly the 6-cell budget (max_cells 6, slots never reassigned).

exposure_form_control.definition: nominal-yield conditioning at the SAME 30 frozen dates: identical rank book (LongTermDebtNoncurrent / Assets, within-sector, long-low/short-high), identical expanding-percentile rule and weight ladder applied to the vintaged DGS10 series (sha256 03dde429... as pinned), identical grid, eligibility, costs, force-flat semantics. This is the scored third arm.
exposure_form_control.runnability: runs from the pinned DGS10 vintage archive + the anchor book machinery alone; 30/30 as-of bindable measured (p2_coverage_gates.json). Cannot-run = DESIGN FAILURE per the P3 lane2 mandate.
exposure_form_control.kill_rule_frozen: if the control's overall expectancy is same-sign vs the anchor AND >= 0.5x |anchor expectancy| (the V12 same-sign >= 0.5x kill standard), the anchor is nominal rate-level beta-timing, not real-rate strain - the family is FALSIFIED (P3 lane2 exposure_form_control mandate).

sham_macro_placebo.definition: duration-preserving block permutation of the anchor's regime-weight sequence: partition the 30-date weight vector into its maximal contiguous blocks of equal w (preserving regime count AND duration distribution by construction - every block's length and label multiset survives, only block ORDER is permuted), permuted once by numpy default_rng seeded with seed = int(wave_sha[:8], 16) mod 2^31 = int('f1fba3c4', 16) mod 2^31 = 1911101388 (seed derived from the frozen wave sha, frozen now, zero free parameters); the permuted weights are applied to the IDENTICAL rank book, grid, eligibility and costs.
sham_macro_placebo.runnability: runs from the anchor cell machinery alone (a rerun with permuted weights); no new data, no new clock, no new eligibility rule.
sham_macro_placebo.kill_rule_frozen: if the sham's overall expectancy is same-sign vs the anchor AND >= 0.5x |anchor expectancy|, the information is generic timing rather than the real-rate regime - the family is FALSIFIED (P3 lane2 sham_macro_placebo mandate).

control_arms.why_both_are_needed: the DGS10 control separates REAL-rate strain from nominal rate-level timing; the sham separates the regime claim from generic date-timing; only the anchor that survives BOTH carries the real-rate-strain claim.

falsification_rule: FROZEN NOW, evaluated in this order, any hit rejects the family, no rescue, no threshold weakening (P-2 margins reported per clause per arm for any survivor): (C1) anchor overall expectancy <= 0 after base band costs. (C2) fewer than 2 of 3 folds with positive expectancy, or max fold MDD > 0.15, or risk-matched SPY excess <= 0 overall, or inherited Stage-A gate table (expectancy > 0, PF >= 1.1, folds positive >= 2, populated-fold PF >= 0.8, ETF positive share <= 0.35) fails without relaxation. (C3) sham-macro placebo same-sign expectancy >= 0.5x |anchor| (seed 1911101388 block permutation as specified). (C4) DGS10 exposure-form control same-sign expectancy >= 0.5x |anchor|. (C5) neighbour (Liabilities/Assets) fails same-sign support. (C6) gate-value clause: the gated anchor expectancy must EXCEED the always-on baseline expectancy; a gate that destroys value falsifies the conditioning claim even if the raw spread survives. (C7) D2 novelty gate: pooled Spearman |rho| > 0.20 vs ANY of the fourteen veto entries, measured on conditioning exposures before selection (fail-closed; V12 precedent). (C8) coverage fail-closed: any fold with < 5 populated decision periods, or any w > 0 decision with zero eligible names.
expected_failure_mode: MOST PLAUSIBLE DEATH: clause C4. Real and nominal 10-year yields share most of their variance over 2018-2025; outside the 2022-2023 inflation-surge divergence the expanding percentiles of DFII10 and DGS10 may label the same dates HIGH/MID/LOW. If so, real-rate conditioning is unfalsifiable-from-nominal-timing on this grid and the family dies by the frozen 0.5x rule - cheaply, at D2/pre-selection, with no scored PnL needed for the kill comparison to be decided. SECOND: clause C1/C2 on cost grounds - the high-leverage short leg skews to low-ADV dead and dying names (dead-leg share of pairs measured 0.72+ in the census), the blended base cost is expected near the band-C 25 bps ceiling and stress x2 is expected to consume any thin margin. THIRD: clause C6 - the always-on leverage spread beats the gated book, i.e., the real-rate regime gate destroys value and the conditioning claim itself is rejected. No clause admits tuning; every death is terminal for the family.
dead_leg_handling: verbatim carry from p3_v13_invariants_freeze.json event_book_invariants: books on DEAD_EVIDENCED legs use death-inclusive price series with exit-at-last-close semantics (V9 carry); no survivorship re-substitution - a dead name is never replaced by a successor entity's series; a fill references only names with a bar at the fill session; zero-eligibility names abstain, counted, never imputed. Additionally declared for this axis: NO death-event timing, NO death-date conditioning, and NO sector-peer death propagation enters any decision of any arm - dead names are ordinary ranked legs only (this is also what keeps the fourteenth veto entry clean). The per-entity and dead/alive split legs are persisted per the diagnostic_output_contract.

expected_fold_population.coverage_fail: a fold with < 5 populated decision periods is COVERAGE_INSUFFICIENT_FAIL_CLOSED, never silently scored (coverage_first_rule carried).
